card.name: Syllable breaks in dictionary headwords
card.fires_on: Syllable pieces inside a dictionary-style respelling such as cu·ta·ne·ous, right after a headword is repeated. Also fires on the sentence-ending period or question mark just before a bullet point.

modes.label: Hyphenation entries
modes.description: A syllable inside a dotted pronunciation breakdown of a medical or dictionary headword.

modes.label: Sentence end before bullet
modes.description: A period or question mark closing a bulleted list item, just before the next bullet.
modes.example: Is it an hour or a hour<<? >>• It is raining.

card.writes: It promotes odd word-start pieces and suppresses periods and bullet marks, so it pushes the next piece of a dotted word rather than sentence punctuation.
card.plain: It lights up on the syllable pieces in dictionary entries that split a word with dots, like cu·ta·ne·ous.
